notes: Checks from the contract (engine/rng.md#spike-testsenginerng, Technical Director; low-bit limits re-baselined 2026-10-02 from tests/engine/rng/limits_model.py, reasoning in engine/rng.md#low-bit-limits). 'stage': 1 = the spike as first built (it reported spike_low5_min/max only); 2 = the spike also reports spike_bit_min and spike_bit_max (reached in commit 9e6c11e: measured 103 and 157, equal to the model). The two interim low-5-bit locks (spike_low5_min == 0, spike_low5_max == 21) were removed by the Technical Director on 2026-10-02, once the four 'ones per block' checks ran: 11 checks. The spike still reports the two spike_low5 labels and check.py still compares them with the model. warmup_frames 600: the whole-period statistics finish at frame 450 after entry (measured: check.py --finish-frame); every memory check reads the finished result. The profile check is a lock: rng_next has no branches and is called on a top-border line with no DMA and no IRQ inside it, so min_cycles = max_cycles = the measured figure (as tests/engine/irq_chain). Its span is rng_next to rng_next_end (the rts label): the rts and the caller's jsr are NOT in it (engine/README.md#which-span-a-figure-is). The model check against the 6502 routine is tests/engine/rng/check.py. Schema: engine/README.md#budget-files.

ones per block, bits 0-4: fewest not too low
checks.source: engine/rng.md#low-bit-limits, requirement 3. Statistic: ones per block of 256 calls for each of bits 0-4, 255 blocks x 5 bits = 1,275 cells; binomial n=256 p=1/2, mean 128, sd 8. Not too uneven: 92-164 is +/- 4.5 sd; a fair source has a cell outside it in 0.56% of periods (5.5% for 96-160). A stuck or biased bit (p >= 0.6) fails. Model: tests/engine/rng/limits_model.py. Generator: measured 103 (seed $1234), equal to the model; 102-103 over 8 seeds (model)

checks.name: ones per block, bits 0-4: fewest not too even
checks.source: engine/rng.md#low-bit-limits, requirement 3. Statistic: ones per block of 256 calls for each of bits 0-4, 255 blocks x 5 bits = 1,275 cells; binomial n=256 p=1/2, mean 128, sd 8. Not too even: a fair source's fewest is 91-108 in 1,000 trials; P(no cell <= 116) = 5e-44. A counter or a short-period generator gives 128 in every cell and fails. Model: tests/engine/rng/limits_model.py
